scripts.build:chrome: npm run bundle:extension && npm run manifest:chrome && npx web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename=openviet_ime-chrome-{version}.zip
scripts.build:firefox: npm run bundle:extension && npm run manifest:firefox && npx web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename=openviet_ime-firefox-{version}.zip
scripts.build:edge: npm run bundle:extension && npm run manifest:chrome && npx web-ext build --overwrite-dest --filename=openviet_ime-edge-{version}.zip
scripts.test: node --test test/avim.test.js test/macro.test.js test/autocomplete.test.js test/syllable-parser.test.js test/vietc-regression.test.js test/phonology-roundtrip.test.js test/mixed-corpus.test.js test/hardcore-edge-cases.test.js
